command:
set -euo pipefail
STATUS=/workspace/omega_runtime/state/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json
PREFLIGHT=/workspace/omega_runtime/state/ASSEMBLY_PREFLIGHT.json
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, pathlib
status=pathlib.Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/state/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json')
out={'status_exists':status.exists()}
if status.exists():
    s=json.loads(status.read_text())
    out['status']=s
    root=pathlib.Path(s.get('repo_root',''))
    out['repo_root']=str(root)
    for rel in ['omega/supervisor.py','omega/supervisor_outer.py','omega/intake.py','omega/assembly.py']:
        p=root/rel
        out.setdefault('files',{})[rel]={'exists':p.exists(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if p.exists() else None}
        if p.exists() and rel in ('omega/supervisor.py','omega/supervisor_outer.py'):
            text=p.read_text(errors='replace')
            out['files'][rel]['markers']={k:(k in text) for k in ['spool_receipt_reconciler','OMEGA_OUTER_SPOOL','assembly_preflight','Compatibility surface for the former OUTER_SPOOL supervisor']}
pre=pathlib.Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/state/ASSEMBLY_PREFLIGHT.json')
out['assembly_preflight']=json.loads(pre.read_text()) if pre.exists() else None
db=pathlib.Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/data/omega_unified.db')
out['unified_db']={'path':str(db),'exists':db.exists(),'size':db.stat().st_size if db.exists() else None}
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
PY
ps -eo pid,lstart,args | grep -E 'omega\.(supervisor|assembly|grid_runtime|relay_entrypoint|spool_receipt_reconciler|telemetry_daemon|master_bridge)' | grep -v grep || true
